alt: Lanterns at a shrine gate in Tokyo, Japan

stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Well placed hotel in Shinjuku, minutes from the station

activities.description: A full day by coach from the LOVE statue in Shinjuku through Meiji shrine, the Imperial Palace gardens and Asakusa, with lunch included.

program.name: Tokyo
program.description: Three nights in Shinjuku, with a full city day and a day out to Mount Fuji and the Hakone lakes.

stops.name: Hiroshima

program.name: Hiroshima
program.description: Two nights beside the station, with a day that pairs the Peace Memorial Park with the island shrine at Miyajima.

expert.name: Aiko
expert.quote: Three cities in nine days is the honest Japan. Shinjuku for the lights, Hiroshima for the quiet, Kansai for the temples.
expert.tip: The Hiroshima hotel is inside the station building, so the early train west costs you nothing in the morning.

summary: Nine days through three cities: Shinjuku with a city day and Mount Fuji, Hiroshima for the Peace Memorial Park and the floating torii gate at Miyajima, then Osaka with Kyoto, Nara and a free day.
included: Included: 8 nights with daily breakfast; Shinkansen bullet train between Tokyo, Hiroshima and Osaka; private airport transfers; full day Tokyo city tour with lunch; Mount Fuji and Hakone day trip; Hiroshima and Miyajima tour; Kyoto and Nara day trip with buffet lunch.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Japan visa fees; other lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
